title: Ordinary normalized monoidal component slice comparison
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring], $W$ a w-contractible affine scheme [sk-def-pe-wlocal], and $U\to W$ an affine w-contractible pro-etale test [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Fix component PullbackData $d_W,d_U$, including their prescribed coefficient factorization and unbounded evaluation [def-sfb-component-slice-comparison-data, lem-sfb-component-pullback-unbounded-evaluation]. There exist literal profinite RestrictionData $r$ and an OrdinaryComparison $e:r_UF_W\cong F_Ur_T$ such that OrdinaryMonoidal holds with precisely schemeCanonicalMonoidal on the scheme restriction. Thus the comparison is fixed on every basis section and respects the balanced tensors and coefficient unit. This statement asserts only the ordinary module square, not its derived internal-Hom comparison.

proof.text: Literal restriction along Over.map on the profinite slices preserves sections and the coefficient. Give it the strong braided sheaf tensor comparison, and transport module actions along the sectionwise coefficient identity. Localization exactness and the balanced tensor universal property give all fields of RestrictionData.

For each w-contractible affine V over U, the two evaluation isomorphisms identify both composites with M(pi_0(V) over pi_0(W)). Insert componentCompositionIso and the scheme localization comparison and use the identity of those sections. Naturality of the normalized Kan unit gives compatibility with restrictions and maps of modules. Cover arbitrary tests and their pairwise overlaps by w-contractible affines; sheaf gluing extends these maps and their inverses to OrdinaryComparison with exactly OrdinaryBasisFormula.

On coefficient sections this comparison is identity, and on pure tensors it acts by identity on both factors. Local pure tensors generate the sheaf tensor. Thus the tensor square commutes and the coefficient identity is its unit square. The scheme tensor structure is the fixed transport from upper star, giving OrdinaryMonoidal.

lean.statement:
theorem component_slice_ordinary_monoidal
    (W : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine W] [IsWContractibleRing Γ(W, ⊤)]
    (U : W.ProEt) [IsAffine U.left] [IsWContractibleRing Γ(U.left, ⊤)]
    (dW : PullbackData Λ W) (dU : PullbackData Λ U.left) :
    ∃ (r : RestrictionData Λ (componentMap W U))
      (e : OrdinaryComparison Λ W U dW dU r),
      OrdinaryMonoidal Λ W U dW dU r (schemeCanonicalMonoidal Λ W U) e
